errors.text: The cited evidence concerns other HEA compositions and phenomena and does not validate Au/Cu segregation, evaporation, or diffusion in AuCoCuNiPt nanoparticles.
The critical onset is left as a broad 600–800 K estimate rather than identifying the experimentally relevant threshold near 673 K.
The claim that icosahedral particles necessarily have higher surface energy and degrade faster than truncated octahedra is asserted without supporting evidence and is not established by the target.
